  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-large" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-large" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-large" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-large"><span class="sqsrte-text-highlight" data-text-attribute-id="1a7573ef-1219-47be-b464-bb6f681183ee"><strong>More Information</strong></span></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>*There is free, unlimited WiFi throughout the house</strong>*<strong>               Smart TV in the living room<br>                  <br></strong>All 4 rooms have private baths with showers (no tubs). Each room also has a second entrance from the deck.&nbsp;<br>All rooms enjoy views of the lake and the ocean ~&nbsp;the lake sits between the house and the beach - approximately 1/4 mile away.<br>The entire upper deck was redone in 2019, new flooring in the kitchen 2021 and bathroom updates in 2024.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">There are two rooms on either side of our spacious living room (scroll to bottom of page for room layout).<br>The South and Garden Rooms are adjacent to each other down one hallway and the Nautical and North Rooms next to each other down the other. While all rooms face the lake and the ocean, the North and South Rooms have superior (larger) views. If you would like to spend time relaxing out on the deck, the South Room offers and bit more privacy, as the common deck wraps around the south end of the house.<br><br><strong>Stairs &amp; Access</strong><br>All rooms are on the second floor- but because the house sits against a hill, the main access is up a series of 1-2 steps (6 total). Inside, the Nautical and North are down a hallway with no steps and the Garden and South are down a hallway up 3 steps.<br><br><strong>Drinking Water</strong><br>Some guests wonder about our tap water. Because we are on a ground water well system, our water is filtered, tested quarterly and is very good!<br><br>Please see our <a href="/bb-policies" target="_blank"><strong>Policies</strong></a>&nbsp;page for more information.</p></div>
